title: Chocklet
desc: Aravind, a college student, falls in love with a newcomer Anjali, unaware that she is the daughter of the Commissioner of Police and his acquaintance, Jayachandran.

title: Kaadhal Sadugudu
desc: Suresh faces opposition from the father of the woman he loves, who refuses their marriage proposal. However, fate has other plans for him.

title: Aazhvaar
desc: Aalwar, a temple priest, leads a peaceful life until his mother and sister are murdered. In an attempt to take revenge, he adopts various disguises to teach a lesson to the perpetrators.

title: Pulival
desc: Kasi, an employee of a supermarket, steals an expensive phone containing explicit videos belonging to a rich businessman Karthik. Hell breaks loose when the videos get uploaded onto the Internet.

title: Sundara Pandiyan
desc: Sundarapandian helps his friend express his feelings to a girl, only to discover she is his long-lost love. Subsequently, as old feelings resurface, their lives are turned upside down.
